authorization: Root approved this conservative rounding interpretation before candidate performance calculation.

clarifications.reason: For odd quantities above 200 shares, upward-rounded $0.005/share commission can exceed the unrounded reserve by half a cent. Forward splits can produce such quantities even when the decision raw close exceeds $5.
clarifications.rule: Both prior-close integer sizing and stressed closing-limit eligibility must satisfy the stated reserve and actual rounded stressed purchase cost <= the committed budget. Never increase a quantity beyond the stated-reserve solution.
clarifications.scope: Numerical cash-envelope correction; no parameter or signal change.

clarifications.rule: Preserve exact units after a verified split. A fractional entitlement remains unresolved until explicit treatment exists; do not invent a cash-in-lieu amount or execute fractional stock under the whole-share policy.
